title: Microservices and serverless stories vs Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript stories on points
question: Does a story about microservices and serverless get more points than a story about Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about microservices and serverless gets more points than a story about Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript.
expect: If true, points per story for microservices and serverless stories should be at least 1.5x the value for Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, microservices and serverless against Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript

group_b.label: Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h303 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h303 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
